verses.sloka: हतान् मन्त्रिसुतान् बुद्ध्वा वानरेण महात्मना ।रावणः संवृताकारश्चकार मतिमुत्तमाम् ।। ५.४६.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: hatān mantrisutān buddhvā vānareṇa mahātmanā ।rāvaṇaḥ saṁvṛtākāraścakāra matimuttamām ।। 5.46.1।।।।

translations.english: Coming to know that the seven sons of the ministers were slain by the great vanara, Ravana, who had concealed his feelings of agony thought of a good plan.
translations.hindi: लंबी भुजाग्नों वाला तथा लोकों को रुलाने वाला रावण पीले नेत्रों वाले हनुमानजी को श्रपने सामने खड़ा देख, भ्रत्यन्त कुपित हुआ

verses.sloka: स विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दुर्धरं चैव राक्षसम् ।प्रघसं भारकर्णं च पञ्च सेनाग्रनायकान् ।। ५.४६.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa virūpākṣayūpākṣau durdharaṁ caiva rākṣasam ।praghasaṁ bhārakarṇaṁ ca pañca senāgranāyakān ।। 5.46.2।।।।

translations.english: The tenheaded Ravana, eager to capture Hanuman, commanded his five army Generals called Virupaksha, Yupaksha, Durdhara, Praghasa and Bhaskarna, who were great warriorstatesmen valiant and, equal to wind in speed.
translations.hindi: वह हनुमानजी का तेजःपुञज शरीर देख मन ही मन शंकित हो सोचने लगा कि, कहीं ये साक्षात्‌ भगवान्‌ नन्दी तो यहाँ नहीं श्रा गए

verses.sloka: सन्दिदेश दशग्रीवो वीरान्नयविशारदान् ।हनुमद्ग्रहणव्यग्रान् वायुवेगसमान् युधि ।। ५.४६.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: sandideśa daśagrīvo vīrānnayaviśāradān ।hanumadgrahaṇavyagrān vāyuvegasamān yudhi ।। 5.46.3।।।।

translations.english: The tenheaded Ravana, eager to capture Hanuman, commanded his five army Generals called Virupaksha, Yupaksha, Durdhara, Praghasa and Bhaskarna, who were great warriorstatesmen valiant and, equal to wind in speed.
translations.hindi: जिन्होंने पहिले मुझे कैलास पर, उसे हिलाने के लिए शाप दिया था जान पड़ता है वे ही वानर का रूप धर कर यहाँ आए हैं; भ्रथवा यह बाणाषुर इस रूप में श्राया है

verses.sloka: यात सेनाग्रगाः सर्वे महाबलपरिग्रहाः ।सवाजिरथमातङ्गाः स कपिः शास्यतामिति ।। ५.४६.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: yāta senāgragāḥ sarve mahābalaparigrahāḥ ।savājirathamātaṅgāḥ sa kapiḥ śāsyatāmiti ।। 5.46.4।।।।

translations.english: "O Army generals march with a large, strong army with horses, chariots and elephants and punish the vanara.

verses.sloka: यत्तैश्च खलु भाव्यं स्यात्तमासाद्य वनालयम् ।कर्म चापि समाधेयं देशकालविरोधिनम् ।। ५.४६.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: yattaiśca khalu bhāvyaṁ syāttamāsādya vanālayam ।karma cāpi samādheyaṁ deśakālavirodhinam ।। 5.46.5।।।।

translations.english: "Go to that forestdweller and make all efforts to impose on him punishment appropriate to time and place (keeping in view the harm he has done).
translations.hindi: इस दुष्ट से पूछो कि, यह कहाँ से आया है ? क्यो प्राया है? शोक यन उजाड्ने से इसका क्या प्रयोजन है ? भौर राक्षसों के तजन से इसे कया लाम हुआ ?

verses.sloka: न ह्यहं तं कपिं मन्ये कर्मणा प्रतितर्कयन् ।सर्वथा तन्महद्भूतं महाबलपरिग्रहम् ।भवेदिन्द्रेण वा सृष्टमस्मदर्थं तपोबलात् ।। ५.४६.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: na hyahaṁ taṁ kapiṁ manye karmaṇā pratitarkayan ।sarvathā tanmahadbhūtaṁ mahābalaparigraham ।bhavedindreṇa vā sṛṣṭamasmadarthaṁ tapobalāt ।। 5.46.6।।।।

translations.english: "Judging again and again from all actions, I do not think he is an ordinary monkey. He is a being endowed with great strength.
translations.hindi: इस दुष्ट से पूछो कि, मेरी इस ग्रगम्यपुरी में किस लिए झाया है र यह हमारे नौकरों से क्यों लड़ा ?

verses.sloka: सनागयक्षगन्धर्वा देवासुरमहर्षयः ।युष्माभिः सहितैः सर्वैर्मया सह विनिर्जिताः ।। ५.४६.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: sanāgayakṣagandharvā devāsuramaharṣayaḥ ।yuṣmābhiḥ sahitaiḥ sarvairmayā saha vinirjitāḥ ।। 5.46.7।।।।

translations.english: "To me it appears he is created by Indra with his ascetic power (for punishing us). I have subdued nagas, yakshas, gandharvas and even gods, asuras and ascetics with your help. So you should certainly bring him here without doing any harm. Capture the monkey forcibly. Do not insult that mighty monkey.
translations.hindi: रावण के वचन सुन, प्रहस्त ने हनुमानजी से कहा--हे कपे ! तुम साथ- घान हो जाम्रो ग्रौर डरो मत

verses.sloka: तैरवश्यं विधातव्यं व्यलीकं किंचिदेव नः ।तदेव नात्र सन्देहः प्रसह्य परिगृह्यताम् ।। ५.४६.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: tairavaśyaṁ vidhātavyaṁ vyalīkaṁ kiṁcideva naḥ ।tadeva nātra sandehaḥ prasahya parigṛhyatām ।। 5.46.8।।।।

translations.english: "To me it appears he is created by Indra with his ascetic power (for punishing us). I have subdued nagas, yakshas, gandharvas and even gods, asuras and ascetics with your help. So you should certainly bring him here without doing any harm. Capture the monkey forcibly. Do not insult that mighty monkey.

verses.sloka: नावमान्यो भवद्भिश्च हरिर्धीरपराक्रमः ।दृष्टा हि हरयः पूर्वं मया विपुलविक्रमाः ।। ५.४६.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: nāvamānyo bhavadbhiśca harirdhīraparākramaḥ ।dṛṣṭā hi harayaḥ pūrvaṁ mayā vipulavikramāḥ ।। 5.46.9।।।।

translations.english: "To me it appears he is created by Indra with his ascetic power (for punishing us). I have subdued nagas, yakshas, gandharvas and even gods, asuras and ascetics with your help. So you should certainly bring him here without doing any harm. Capture the monkey forcibly. Do not insult that mighty monkey.

verses.sloka: वाली च सहसुग्रीवो जाम्बवांश्च महाबलः ।नीलः सेनापतिश्चैव ये चान्ये द्विविदादयः ।। ५.४६.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: vālī ca sahasugrīvo jāmbavāṁśca mahābalaḥ ।nīlaḥ senāpatiścaiva ye cānye dvividādayaḥ ।। 5.46.10।।।।

translations.english: "Earlier I have seen monkeys of immense prowess, like Vali and Sugriva as well as Jambavan, the bear. Also I have seen the army general, Nila, Dvivida and others. They do not have such tremendous splendour or movement valour, intellect and strength and energy. They did not have such ability to change form at their will.
translations.hindi: झथवा यदि तुम कुबेर के,'यम के या वरुण के दूत हो और यह सुन्दर रूप घर कर, तुम हमारी इस पुरी में ग्राए हो, तो भी ठीक-ठीक बतला दो ।। 8 विष्णुना प्रेषितो वापि दूतो विजयकाडक्षिणा । न हि ते वानरं तेजो रूपमात्रं तु वानरम्‌

verses.sloka: नैवं तेषां गतिर्भीमा न तेजो न पराक्रमः ।न मतिर्न बलोत्साहौ न रूपपरिकल्पनम् ।। ५.४६.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: naivaṁ teṣāṁ gatirbhīmā na tejo na parākramaḥ ।na matirna balotsāhau na rūpaparikalpanam ।। 5.46.11।।।।

translations.english: "Earlier I have seen monkeys of immense prowess, like Vali and Sugriva as well as Jambavan, the bear. Also I have seen the army general, Nila, Dvivida and others. They do not have such tremendous splendour or movement valour, intellect and strength and energy. They did not have such ability to change form at their will.
translations.hindi: है वानर ! यदि तुम सब हाल ठीक-ठीक बतला दोगे, तो तुम भ्रभी छुड़वा दिए जाधोगे श्लौर यदि झूठ बोले तो जान से मरवा दिए, बाप्नोगे

verses.sloka: महत्सत्त्वमिदं ज्ञेयं कपिरूपं व्यवस्थितम् ।प्रयत्नं महदास्थाय क्रियतामस्य निग्रहः ।। ५.४६.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: mahatsattvamidaṁ jñeyaṁ kapirūpaṁ vyavasthitam ।prayatnaṁ mahadāsthāya kriyatāmasya nigrahaḥ ।। 5.46.12।।।।

translations.english: "It should be understood that he has taken the form of a monkey. You have to put in extraordinary effort to capture him by acting in a suitable manner.
translations.hindi: लुम रावण की इस पुरी में राने का ठीक-ठीक कारण बतला दो । जब प्रहृस्त ने इस प्रकार कपिश्रेष्ठ से कहा

verses.sloka: कामं लोकास्त्रयः सेन्द्राः ससुरासुरमानवाः ।भवतामग्रतः स्थातुं न पर्याप्ता रणाजिरे ।। ५.४६.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: kāmaṁ lokāstrayaḥ sendrāḥ sasurāsuramānavāḥ ।bhavatāmagrataḥ sthātuṁ na paryāptā raṇājire ।। 5.46.13।।।।

translations.english: "Even Indra, suras, asuras and humans and the three worlds together are incompetent to stand before you in a battlefield.

verses.sloka: तथापि तु नयज्ञेन जयमाकाङ्क्षता रणे ।आत्मा रक्ष्यः प्रयत्नेन युद्धसिद्धिर्हि चञ्चला ।। ५.४६.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tathāpi tu nayajñena jayamākāṅkṣatā raṇe ।ātmā rakṣyaḥ prayatnena yuddhasiddhirhi cañcalā ।। 5.46.14।।।।

translations.english: "Even then, you should safeguard yourself with great effort adopting warstrategies in an intelligent manner to be victorious, for success in war is uncertain.
translations.hindi: तब हनुमानजी ने कहा--में न तो इन्द्र का ग्रौर न यम का दूत हूँ । न कुबेर के साथ मेरा मेल है और न में विष्णु की प्रेरणा से यहाँ धराया हँ १३॥ जातिरेव सम त्वेषा वानरोऽहमिहागतः । दशेने ररक्षसेसत्रस्य दुलेभं तदिदं मया

verses.sloka: ते स्वामिवचनं सर्वे प्रतिगृह्य महौजसः ।समुत्पेतुर्महावेगा हुताशसमतेजसः ।। ५.४६.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: te svāmivacanaṁ sarve pratigṛhya mahaujasaḥ ।samutpeturmahāvegā hutāśasamatejasaḥ ।। 5.46.15।।।।

translations.english: Taking King's order, the strong and swift warriors, resplendent as the flame of sacrificial fire sallied forth with their army on chariots, on the back of rutting elephants, some on swift horses equipped with sharp weapons of many kinds.

verses.sloka: रथैर्मत्तैश्च मातङ्गैर्वाजिभिश्च महाजवैः ।श्स्त्रैश्च विविधैस्तीक्ष्णैः सर्वैश्चोपचिता बलैः ।। ५.४६.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: rathairmattaiśca mātaṅgairvājibhiśca mahājavaiḥ ।śstraiśca vividhaistīkṣṇaiḥ sarvaiścopacitā balaiḥ ।। 5.46.16।।।।

translations.english: Taking King's order, the strong and swift warriors, resplendent as the flame of sacrificial fire sallied forth with their army on chariots, on the back of rutting elephants, some on swift horses equipped with sharp weapons of many kinds.
translations.hindi: में उनसे भपने शरीर की रक्षा के लिए लड़ा । मुझे क्या देवता भौर क्या असुर, कोई भो भ्रस्त्रपाश से नहीं बाँध सकता \

verses.sloka: ततस्तं ददृशुर्वीरा दीप्यमानं महाकपिम् ।रश्मिमन्तमिवोद्यन्तं स्वतेजोरश्मिमालिनम् ।। ५.४६.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastaṁ dadṛśurvīrā dīpyamānaṁ mahākapim ।raśmimantamivodyantaṁ svatejoraśmimālinam ।। 5.46.17।।।।

translations.english: The heroic giants caught sight of the vanara, who was blazing encircled as though he was by the rays of his own glory, looking like the rising Sun. He was endowed with extraordinary agility, intelligence, and tremendous strength standing, waiting at the archway.
translations.hindi: स्वयं पितामह ब्रह्माजी से ही मझको यह वर मिला है। सो मे झपनी इच्छा ही से, राक्षसराज से भेंटने के लिए, ब्रह्मास्त्र से बंध गया हू

verses.sloka: तोरणस्थं महोत्साहं महासत्त्वं महाबलम् ।महामतिं महावेगं महाकायं महाबलम् ।। ५.४६.१८।।।।
verses.transliteration: toraṇasthaṁ mahotsāhaṁ mahāsattvaṁ mahābalam ।mahāmatiṁ mahāvegaṁ mahākāyaṁ mahābalam ।। 5.46.18।।।।

translations.english: The heroic giants caught sight of the vanara, who was blazing encircled as though he was by the rays of his own glory, looking like the rising Sun. He was endowed with extraordinary agility, intelligence, and tremendous strength standing, waiting at the archway.

verses.sloka: तं समीक्ष्यैव ते सर्वे दिक्षु सर्वास्ववस्थिताः ।तैस्तैः प्रहरणैर्भीमैरभिपेतुस्ततस्ततः ।। ५.४६.१९।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ samīkṣyaiva te sarve dikṣu sarvāsvavasthitāḥ ।taistaiḥ praharaṇairbhīmairabhipetustatastataḥ ।। 5.46.19।।।।

translations.english: Having observed the tremendous strength, intelligence and swiftness in action of Hanuman, the generals of the army positioned at all directions and assailed him with dreadful weapons.

verses.sloka: तस्य पञ्चायसास्तीक्ष्णाः शिताः पीतमुखाः शराः ।शिरस्युत्पलपत्राभा दुर्धरेण निपातिताः ।। ५.४६.२०।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya pañcāyasāstīkṣṇāḥ śitāḥ pītamukhāḥ śarāḥ ।śirasyutpalapatrābhā durdhareṇa nipātitāḥ ।। 5.46.20।।।।

translations.english: Durdhara pierced into the head of Hanuman with five sharp arrows and polished steel shafts with yellow tips (gold) shining like red lotus petals. They were like petals of lilies thrown on the head of Hanuman (causing no pain).

verses.sloka: स तैः पञ्चभिराविद्धः शरैः शिरसि वानरः ।उत्पपात नदन् व्योम्नि दिशो दश विनादयन् ।। ५.४६.२१।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taiḥ pañcabhirāviddhaḥ śaraiḥ śirasi vānaraḥ ।utpapāta nadan vyomni diśo daśa vinādayan ।। 5.46.21।।।।

translations.english: With five arrows pierced in the head of the vanara, Hanuman leaped into the sky with terrible roar, which resounded in all the ten directions.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु दुर्धरो वीरः सरथः सज्यकार्मुकः ।किरन् शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैरभिपेदे महाबलः ।। ५.४६.२२।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu durdharo vīraḥ sarathaḥ sajyakārmukaḥ ।kiran śaraśataistīkṣṇairabhipede mahābalaḥ ।। 5.46.22।।।।

translations.english: Then the powerful, hero, Durdhara, mounted on his chariot, fastened his bowstring and hit Hanuman with hundreds of sharp arrows.

verses.sloka: स कपिर्वारयामास तं व्योम्नि शरवर्षिणम् ।वृष्टिमन्तं पयोदान्ते पयोदमिव मारुतः ।। ५.४६.२३।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa kapirvārayāmāsa taṁ vyomni śaravarṣiṇam ।vṛṣṭimantaṁ payodānte payodamiva mārutaḥ ।। 5.46.23।।।।

translations.english: The great monkey kept away the showering arrows like the wind prevents raincloud from showering rain drops at the end of monsoon.

verses.sloka: अर्द्यमानस्ततस्तेन दुर्धरेणानिलात्मजः ।चकार कदनं भूयो व्यवर्धत च वेगवान् ।। ५.४६.२४।।।।
verses.transliteration: ardyamānastatastena durdhareṇānilātmajaḥ ।cakāra kadanaṁ bhūyo vyavardhata ca vegavān ।। 5.46.24।।।।

translations.english: When the son of the Windgod was attacked by Durdhara, he again grew in size

verses.sloka: स दूरं सहसोत्पत्य दुर्धरस्य रथे हरिः ।निपपात महवेगो विद्युद्राशिर्गिराविव ।। ५.४६.२५।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa dūraṁ sahasotpatya durdharasya rathe hariḥ ।nipapāta mahavego vidyudrāśirgirāviva ।। 5.46.25।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman suddenly leaped far off into the air at high speed and fell on Durdhara's chariot just like a thunderous lightning falls on a mountain.

verses.sloka: ततः स मथिताष्टाश्वं रथं भग्नाक्षकूबरम् ।विहाय न्यपतद्भूमौ दुर्धरस्त्यक्तजीवितः ।। ५.४६.२६।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa mathitāṣṭāśvaṁ rathaṁ bhagnākṣakūbaram ।vihāya nyapatadbhūmau durdharastyaktajīvitaḥ ।। 5.46.26।।।।

translations.english: Having lost his chariot, the horses yoked to it killed, its axle and pole broken to pieces, Durdhara fell down dead from the chariot.

verses.sloka: तं विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दृष्ट्वा निपतितं भुवि ।सञ्जातरोषौ दुर्धर्षावुत्पेततुररिन्दमौ ।। ५.४६.२७।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ virūpākṣayūpākṣau dṛṣṭvā nipatitaṁ bhuvi ।sañjātaroṣau durdharṣāvutpetaturarindamau ।। 5.46.27।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the body of Durdhara fallen on the ground, enraged Virupaksha and Yupaksha, the unassailable crushers of enemies leaped towards him.

verses.sloka: स ताभ्यां सहसोत्पत्य विष्ठितो विमले ऽम्बरे ।मुद्गराभ्यां महाबाहुर्वक्षस्यभिहतः कपिः ।। ५.४६.२८।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tābhyāṁ sahasotpatya viṣṭhito vimale 'mbare ।mudgarābhyāṁ mahābāhurvakṣasyabhihataḥ kapiḥ ।। 5.46.28।।।।

translations.english: As the strongarmed vanara stood stationed in the clear white sky both the generals leaped into the sky and hit him all of a sudden with two iron hammers.

verses.sloka: तयोर्वेगवतोर्वेगं विनिहत्य महाबलः ।निपपात पुनर्भूमौ सुपर्णसमविक्रमः ।। ५.४६.२९।।।।
verses.transliteration: tayorvegavatorvegaṁ vinihatya mahābalaḥ ।nipapāta punarbhūmau suparṇasamavikramaḥ ।। 5.46.29।।।।

translations.english: Powerful Hanuman, an equal to Garuda in valour fell down while resisting the swift generals.

verses.sloka: स सालवृक्षमासाद्य तमुत्पाट्य च वानरः ।तावुभौ राक्षसौ वीरौ जघान पवनात्मजः ।। ५.४६.३०।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa sālavṛkṣamāsādya tamutpāṭya ca vānaraḥ ।tāvubhau rākṣasau vīrau jaghāna pavanātmajaḥ ।। 5.46.30।।।।

translations.english: Then the son of the Windgod seized a sala tree uprooted it, lifted it and smashed the two giant generals with it.

verses.sloka: ततस्तांस्त्रीन् हतान् ज्ञात्वा वानरेण तरस्विना ।अभिपेदे महावेगः प्रसह्य प्रघसो हरिम् ।। ५.४६.३१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastāṁstrīn hatān jñātvā vānareṇa tarasvinā ।abhipede mahāvegaḥ prasahya praghaso harim ।। 5.46.31।।।।

translations.english: Finding all the three generals dead, swift Praghasa advanced towards the Vanara and attacked him. Valiant Bhasakarna also lifted a trident and attacked him. Both were famous for swift and violent action in war

verses.sloka: भासकर्णश्च संक्रुद्धः शूलमादाय वीर्यवान् ।एकतः कपिशार्दूलं यशस्विनमवस्थितम् ।। ५.४६.३२।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhāsakarṇaśca saṁkruddhaḥ śūlamādāya vīryavān ।ekataḥ kapiśārdūlaṁ yaśasvinamavasthitam ।। 5.46.32।।।।

translations.english: Finding all the three generals dead, swift Praghasa advanced towards the Vanara and attacked him. Valiant Bhasakarna also lifted a trident and attacked him. Both were famous for swift and violent action in war

verses.sloka: पट्टिशेन शिताग्रेण प्रघसः प्रत्ययोधयत् ।भासकर्णश्च शूलेन राक्षसः कपिसत्तमम् ।। ५.४६.३३।।।।
verses.transliteration: paṭṭiśena śitāgreṇa praghasaḥ pratyayodhayat ।bhāsakarṇaśca śūlena rākṣasaḥ kapisattamam ।। 5.46.33।।।।

translations.english: Praghasa fought back the glorious tiger among vanaras with a sharp crowbar on one side and Bhaskarana attacked with a spear from the other.

verses.sloka: स ताभ्यां विक्षतैर्गात्रैरसृग्दिग्धतनूरुहः ।अभवद्वानरः क्रुद्धो बालसूर्यसमप्रभः ।। ५.४६.३४।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tābhyāṁ vikṣatairgātrairasṛgdigdhatanūruhaḥ ।abhavadvānaraḥ kruddho bālasūryasamaprabhaḥ ।। 5.46.34।।।।

translations.english: Attacked by both the generals, the fur on the vanara's body was smeared with blood from his wounded limbs, shining like the rising Sun smeared with blood became furious.

verses.sloka: समुत्पाट्य गिरेः शृङ्गं समृगव्यालपादपम् ।जघान हनुमान् वीरो राक्षसौ कपिकुञ्जरः ।। ५.४६.३५।।।।
verses.transliteration: samutpāṭya gireḥ śṛṅgaṁ samṛgavyālapādapam ।jaghāna hanumān vīro rākṣasau kapikuñjaraḥ ।। 5.46.35।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, a courageous and mighty elephant among the monkeys uprooted a mountain peak along with its animals, serpents and trees and killed both the demon generals.

verses.sloka: ततस्तेष्ववसन्नेषु सेनापतिषु पञ्चसु ।बलं तदवशेषं च नाशयास वानरः ।। ५.४६.३६।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣvavasanneṣu senāpatiṣu pañcasu ।balaṁ tadavaśeṣaṁ ca nāśayāsa vānaraḥ ।। 5.46.36।।।।

translations.english: When the five army chiefs were killed, Hanuman began to destoy the remaining army force.

verses.sloka: अश्वैरश्वान् गजैर्नागान् योधैर्योधान् रथै रथान् ।स कपिर्नाशयामास सहस्राक्ष इवासुरान् ।। ५.४६.३७।।।।
verses.transliteration: aśvairaśvān gajairnāgān yodhairyodhān rathai rathān ।sa kapirnāśayāmāsa sahasrākṣa ivāsurān ।। 5.46.37।।।।

translations.english: The vanara pitted horses against horses, elephants against elephants, warriors against warriors and chariots against chariots as Indra destroyed demons.

verses.sloka: हतैर्नागैश्च तुरगैर्भग्नाक्षैश्च महारथैः ।हतैश्च राक्षसैर्भूमी रुद्धमार्गा समन्ततः ।। ५.४६.३८।।।।
verses.transliteration: hatairnāgaiśca turagairbhagnākṣaiśca mahārathaiḥ ।hataiśca rākṣasairbhūmī ruddhamārgā samantataḥ ।। 5.46.38।।।।

translations.english: There was no path (one could not move forward) with elephants, and horses killed and with broken axles of great chariots and smashed chariots spread all over the way.

verses.sloka: ततः कपिस्तान् ध्वजिनीपतीन् रणे निहत्य वीरान् सबलान् सवाहनान् ।समीक्ष्य वीरः परिगृह्य तोरणं कृतक्षणः काल इव प्रजाक्षये ।। ५.४६.३९।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kapistān dhvajinīpatīn raṇe nihatya vīrān sabalān savāhanān ।samīkṣya vīraḥ parigṛhya toraṇaṁ kṛtakṣaṇaḥ kāla iva prajākṣaye ।। 5.46.39।।

translations.english: Then the heroic monkey having killed the army generals and their army and destroyed their vehicles in war came back to the archway after reviewing and stood like the timespirit bent upon the destruction of humanity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
